The reaction between hydrogen and oxygen releases 486kJ/mol of energy.
2H2(g)+O2(g)→2H2O(g)
The bond energy of H–H is 436kJ/mol and that of H–O is 464kJ/mol.
What is the bond energy of O=O?
A
430kJ/mol
B
458kJ/mol
C
498kJ/mol
D
984kJ/mol
